_comment: Sidecar manifest required next to every new ESP32 counting recording (<file>.json). Checked by V4/src/validate_recording.py.

required.count: integer 0-5: people inside the room for the WHOLE recording
required.session_id: string: one session = one sitting of the same boards, layout and channel
required.chip: esp32 | esp32s2 | esp32s3 | esp32c3 | esp32c5 | esp32c6
required.traffic_condition: quiet | normal | congested (write what you measured, e.g. number of visible APs)
required.people_activity: list, one entry per person: sitting | standing | walking | mixed
required.people_positions: list or free text: where each person was
required.empty_reference_file: file_id of the 30 s empty recording made for this session (or null if this IS the reference)
required.notes: free text: fans/AC on, door open, anything unusual

optional.video_ground_truth: path to a video or count log if one exists
